name: World Headlines
overview: Understand major international developments in their timeline.
practice: Compare reporting dates and locate primary statements.

name: United States News
overview: Follow verified public affairs and policy reporting.
practice: Distinguish national rules from state-level differences.

name: Europe & EU
overview: Explore European institutions, policy and regional events.
practice: Check whether a rule applies EU-wide or nationally.

name: Asia Pacific
overview: Read regional trade, society and diplomatic developments.
practice: Compare local sources across multiple countries.

name: Middle East
overview: Understand regional developments with geographical context.
practice: Separate verified statements from unconfirmed claims.

name: Africa & Emerging Regions
overview: Explore public affairs, economies and cross-border events.
practice: Use original statistical releases where available.

name: Global Politics
overview: Understand institutions, parties and policy processes neutrally.
practice: Distinguish factual officeholders from opinion and forecasts.

name: Elections & Voting
overview: Learn election systems and public result reporting.
practice: Rely on official electoral authorities for voter procedures.

name: Government & Policy
overview: Track public policy announcements and implementation.
practice: Check enacted rules rather than only proposals.

name: International Law
overview: Understand treaties, courts and legal jurisdiction.
practice: Seek qualified legal sources for country-specific decisions.

name: Human Rights
overview: Explore treaty frameworks and published monitoring methods.
practice: Review definitions, evidence quality and source dates.

name: Global Diplomacy
overview: Understand bilateral agreements and multilateral forums.
practice: Distinguish signed agreements from negotiation statements.

name: Country Profiles
overview: Compare national institutions and basic public indicators.
practice: Preserve data years to avoid misleading comparisons.

name: Population Statistics
overview: Understand census counts, estimates and projections.
practice: Compare definitions and measurement years.

name: Economic Rankings
overview: Review GDP, growth and other published country metrics.
practice: Note PPP versus nominal rankings and missing countries.

name: World Maps & Geography
overview: Explore borders, distances and regional geography.
practice: Consult authoritative map sources for disputed boundaries.

name: Cricket
overview: Understand formats, fixtures and score terminology.
practice: Use official schedules for match times and results.

name: Football
overview: Follow leagues, tournaments and team information.
practice: Check competition rules and season-specific standings.

name: Basketball
overview: Explore league formats, player statistics and schedules.
practice: Distinguish per-game from aggregate statistics.

name: Tennis
overview: Understand ranking systems, surfaces and tournament draws.
practice: Check live match data against official organizers.

name: Motorsport
overview: Explore race formats, qualifying and engineering terms.
practice: Check governing-body calendars and safety updates.

name: Olympics & Athletics
overview: Understand event formats and qualification structures.
practice: Distinguish historical records from current rankings.

name: Movies & TV
overview: Explore releases, reviews and distribution regions.
practice: Verify release dates against distributors and markets.

name: Music & Culture
overview: Review genre histories, releases and cultural contexts.
practice: Respect copyright and verify artist credits.

name: Gaming & Esports
overview: Learn competitive formats, release updates and major events.
practice: Distinguish official patch notes from rumors.

name: Books & Arts
overview: Explore literary releases, creators and exhibitions.
practice: Credit sources and preserve publication dates.

name: Global Events
overview: Plan around significant international events.
practice: Use organizers' published schedules and time zones.

name: Public Holidays
overview: Understand differing national holiday observances.
practice: Check regional applicability and government notices.

name: Festivals & Traditions
overview: Explore cultural observances and their local meanings.
practice: Do not assume traditions are identical across communities.

name: World Data Explorer
overview: Learn how to compare public international datasets.
practice: Document source, coverage, revision and unit differences.
